description: Saved items / wishlist: full end-to-end feature — migration, SavedItem model, User model relation, SavedItemController, routes, heart toggle on card and show views, saved index view, and Alpine savedItem component. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 in terms of code, but must run after them in migration order.
steps: Create database/migrations/2026_10_13_000003_create_saved_items_table.php. up(): Schema::create('saved_items', function (Blueprint $table) { $table->id(); $table->foreignId('user_id')->constrained()->cascadeOnDelete(); $table->foreignId('product_id')->constrained()->cascadeOnDelete(); $table->timestamps(); $table->unique(['user_id', 'product_id']); }); down(): Schema::dropIfExists('saved_items');

Create app/Models/SavedItem.php: namespace App\Models; use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model; use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo; class SavedItem extends Model { protected $fillable = ['user_id', 'product_id']; public function user(): BelongsTo { return $this->belongsTo(User::class); } public function product(): BelongsTo { return $this->belongsTo(Product::class); } }

Modify app/Models/User.php: (a) Add import: use App\Models\SavedItem;. (b) Add relation: public function savedItems(): HasMany { return $this->hasMany(SavedItem::class); }. (c) Add helper: public function hasSavedProduct(int $productId): bool { return $this->savedItems()->where('product_id', $productId)->exists(); }

Create app/Http/Controllers/Account/SavedItemController.php: namespace App\Http\Controllers\Account; use App\Http\Controllers\Controller; use App\Models\Product; use App\Models\SavedItem; use Illuminate\Http\Request; use Illuminate\View\View; use Illuminate\Http\RedirectResponse; use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response; class SavedItemController extends Controller { public function index(Request $request): View { $saved = $request->user()->savedItems()->with('product.shop')->latest()->paginate(16); return view('account.saved.index', compact('saved')); } public function store(Request $request, Product $product): Response { if (!$product->is_active || !$product->shop?->is_active) { abort(404); } SavedItem::firstOrCreate(['user_id' => $request->user()->id, 'product_id' => $product->id]); if ($request->expectsJson()) { return response()->json(['saved' => true]); } return back(); } public function destroy(Request $request, Product $product): Response { $request->user()->savedItems()->where('product_id', $product->id)->delete(); if ($request->expectsJson()) { return response()->json(['saved' => false]); } return back(); } }

Modify routes/web.php: (a) Add import at top: use App\Http\Controllers\Account\SavedItemController;. (b) Inside the existing Route::middleware('auth')->group() block, add: Route::get('/account/saved', [SavedItemController::class, 'index'])->middleware(EnsureUserHasRole::class.':buyer')->name('account.saved.index'); Route::post('/account/saved/{product}', [SavedItemController::class, 'store'])->middleware([EnsureUserHasRole::class.':buyer', 'throttle:30,1'])->name('account.saved.store'); Route::delete('/account/saved/{product}', [SavedItemController::class, 'destroy'])->middleware([EnsureUserHasRole::class.':buyer', 'throttle:30,1'])->name('account.saved.destroy');

Create resources/views/account/saved/index.blade.php. Extend 'layouts.app'. Title: 'Saved Items · FarSell'. Content: a heading 'Saved Items', then an @forelse over $saved (each $savedItem — access $savedItem->product). Include the product card partial with @include('catalog.partials.card', ['product' => $savedItem->product]). Use a responsive grid matching catalog/index (grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3). @empty show 'No saved items yet.' with a link to route('catalog.index'). Include pagination: $saved->links().

Modify resources/views/catalog/partials/card.blade.php: Wrap the entire <a> in a <div class='relative'>. Add a heart toggle button positioned absolutely at top-right of the card image area. The button uses x-data="savedItem(@js($product->id), @js(auth()->check() && auth()->user()->hasSavedProduct($product->id)))" and @click.prevent="toggle()". Render a filled heart SVG when saved=true, outline heart when saved=false. Only render the button when auth()->check() && auth()->user()->role === App\Enums\UserRole::Buyer. Use Heroicons heart SVG (inline). Apply aria-label='Save item' / 'Remove from saved'. Style: absolute top-2 right-2, p-1.5, rounded-full, bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-sm, text-rose-500 when saved.

Modify resources/views/catalog/show.blade.php: Add a heart toggle button near the product title/price area (after the shop link, before the h1, or after the price — pick: after the price line). Same Alpine savedItem component binding as card.blade.php. Only render for authenticated buyers.

Add Alpine.data('savedItem', ...) component to resources/js/app.js (before Alpine.start()). The component: (productId, initialSaved) => ({ saved: initialSaved, async toggle() { const url = `/account/saved/${productId}`; const method = this.saved ? 'DELETE' : 'POST'; try { const res = await fetch(url, { method, headers: { 'X-CSRF-TOKEN': document.querySelector('meta[name=csrf-token]')?.content ?? '', Accept: 'application/json' } }); if (res.ok) { const data = await res.json(); this.saved = data.saved; } } catch (_) {} } })

Create tests/Feature/SavedItemTest.php. Cover: authenticated buyer can save a product (POST 201 or redirect), saving twice is idempotent (no duplicate error), buyer can unsave (DELETE), guest is redirected to login on POST, index shows saved products, index is empty when no saves.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated buyer can POST /account/saved/{product} and product appears in GET /account/saved
Posting a duplicate save does not throw a unique constraint error
Guest is redirected to /login when hitting any saved-items route
Heart button renders on catalog cards for authenticated buyers
Heart button renders on product show page for authenticated buyers
npm run build compiles without errors (Alpine component added correctly)
findings: All 9 steps implemented. Migration created and ran (saved_items table with unique(user_id, product_id)). SavedItem model, User.savedItems relation and hasSavedProduct helper added. SavedItemController uses firstOrCreate for idempotent saves. Three routes added inside auth middleware group. Heart toggle button added to card.blade.php (inside image div, @click.prevent) and show.blade.php (after price). Saved index view extends layouts.app. Alpine savedItem component registered in app.js with X-CSRF-TOKEN header. SavedItemTest: 7/7 pass. CatalogFilterTest: 7/7 pass. npm run build: success (60 modules, no errors).
